description: Search businesses in a single Mexican state by keyword — matches against name, activity, or address. Use this for state-scoped queries that need more than just business name (e.g., "panaderia", "ferreteria"). Returns paginated results.

keyword.description: Search term — matches name, economic activity description, or address text.

state_code.description: Two-digit state code "01"-"32" (required — use denue_search_by_name with "00" for nationwide).

name: denue_search_in_state
